annotations.title: Save, restore or re-rule a workbook

description: Saves, replaces, restores or re-rules a workbook directly — no run, no charge. Save text you edited (`document`, or `sheets`, with the `base_version` you read); restore or undo to an earlier version (`restore_version` alone — no need to read first); or set its schema, the rules every edit must hold (`schema` alone, e.g. dates must be YYYY-MM-DD). Write in the workbook's form: read_workbook's `file_type` and `edit_as` say what its tabs hold — markdown for docx, a table per sheet for xlsx, one svg per slide for pptx, LaTeX/Typst for an editable pdf, glTF JSON for glb. Every save is compiled to that file type and against the schema; a failing one is refused with each error's tab and line. `check_only` compiles the same edit (text, tabs or schema) and says what a save would be told, saving nothing: check, fix, then save.

base_schema_version.description: With `schema`: the schema version you read; 0 where it had none.

base_version.description: The version you read and changed.

check_only.description: true to compile this edit and say what a save would be told, without saving.

document.description: The new text of a one-tab workbook.

from_file.description: An uploaded file (/attachments/<workbook>/<name>, as create_workbook's or upload's link names it, or a drive path) made the workbook's next version through its file type's import — its first, or a revised file (a remodelled .glb, a new export of the spreadsheet) over earlier versions, which stay restorable. To revise a workbook from a new file: upload it to /attachments/<this workbook>/<name>, then this.

restore_version.description: An earlier version to make current again, as a new version.

schema.description: The whole new schema: a ```tables fence of JSON, and optionally a ```tla module.

sheets.description: Every tab in its new order. Tab ids come from read_workbook's `tabs`.

id.description: An existing tab's id. Omit to add a new tab.

markdown.description: The tab's new content. Omit to keep it as it is.

name.description: A new name for the tab, or the name of a new tab.
